description: This file defines client-side logic for the 'Plant Analysis' form in a Frappe-based ERPNext application. It includes event handlers for 'onload' and 'refresh' events that control form behavior and UI element visibility.

methods.name: onload
methods.description: Handler executed when the form loads; loads content if criteria are undefined.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Handler executed on form refresh; hides specific map tool elements.
